title: Receipt enqueue failures are silently ignored in process_update
description: When a user marks a message as read (Message/set update readAt), the code silently ignores receipt enqueue failures. Correct because: receipt delivery is best-effort, not core contract; failure must not fail the readAt update (UX impact); outbox retry loop handles eventual delivery or exhaustion. Alternative: propagate as HTTP error rejected because would unnecessarily couple UX to delivery infrastructure.
